calculation.expression: rolling_40d compounded return of (asset daily return - rolling beta to equal-weight cross-asset benchmark * benchmark daily return)
calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, estimate beta using the prior 40 completed returns against the equal-weight mean return of the 15-instrument universe, then compound the asset's beta-adjusted returns. Signal is lagged one day to prevent lookahead.

validation.regime_notes: Failed daily ICIR admission gate; retained only as a rejected research record.
